entities.name: Iambic Therapeutics, Inc.
entities.description: AI drug discovery company, listed on Nasdaq in October 2026, with a technology collaboration with Nvidia.

cash_and_undrawn.note: Cash and cash equivalents before IPO net proceeds of about $156.0 million (ev_170009).

credit.collateral_note: No GPU collateral; clinical stage drug developer.
credit.grade_reason: Only liquidity is sourced (cash $252.0 million at 2026-09-30, runway into or through Q4 2028); fewer than two rubric columns.
credit.notes: Iambic says existing cash funds operations into or through the fourth quarter of 2028 (ev_170011). Subordinated convertible notes of $66.5 million issued Aug to Sep 2026 converted at the IPO.

relationships.title: Nvidia preferred stock in Iambic Therapeutics (Series B 2023 and Series B-4 2026)
relationships.insight_template: Nvidia put {funded} into {counterparty}, a drug developer that also optimizes its models on Nvidia hardware; the loss is capped at cost.
relationships.definition: Nvidia bought Iambic Series B convertible preferred stock for $20.0 million in the round sold from September to December 2023, and Series B-4 preferred for $5.0 million in May 2026. Iambic's prospectus names Nvidia as a holder of more than 5% at the time of the Series B and as a party to its investors' rights and voting agreements. The preferred converted into common stock at Iambic's October 2026 IPO at $16.00 per share. Nvidia is also a technology collaboration partner of Iambic.

reconciliation.nvidia_side: No disclosure found as of 2026-11-23. Iambic is absent from Nvidia's 13F-HR through the quarter ended 2026-09-30, which predates Iambic's October 2026 listing; Nvidia's filings do not name private investees of this size.
reconciliation.counterparty_side: Iambic's 424B4 of 2026-10-15 lists Nvidia's Series B purchase ($20.0 million, 1,536,034 shares) and Series B-4 purchase ($5.0 million, 291,658 shares), and names Nvidia as a former 5% holder and a party to the investors' rights and voting agreements (ev_170001, ev_170002, ev_170004).

credit.wwr_reason: Equity loss is capped at cost and tracks biotech and AI sentiment; it does not grow as Iambic weakens.
credit.notes: Preferred converted to common at the IPO; Nvidia's current share count and stake after the IPO are not disclosed in the prospectus.

first_order.trigger: Iambic's drug candidates fail or the stock falls below the Series B price
first_order.mechanism: Mark to market loss on a listed stake
first_order.text: If Iambic's clinical programs disappoint, Nvidia's $25.0 million cost in Iambic is at risk, which is immaterial to Nvidia.

first_order.trigger: Iambic runs its NeuralPLexer and Enchant models on Nvidia hardware
first_order.text: Iambic's collaboration to optimize its models on Nvidia hardware ties part of Nvidia's investment to future Nvidia platform use.

second_order.text: Iambic lists Nvidia as an investor and partner in its IPO prospectus, so a later Nvidia sale would remove a visible backer of Iambic.

counterparty_equity_raised.note: Preferred stock, convertible notes and SAFEs combined, before the IPO.

relationships.notes: Found by R2 (Q9 beneficial owner hit on the S-1 investors' rights agreement exhibit). Nvidia is also a co-owner of a NeuralPLexer patent family with Caltech (S-1/A). IPO at $16.00 (ev_170006). Not in Nvidia's 13F through 2026-09-30; check the 13F for the quarter ending 2026-12-31.

holding.note: Preferred shares bought (1,536,034 Series B plus 291,658 Series B-4) as stated in the prospectus; holdings after conversion not disclosed.

events.summary: Iambic completes its Series B, sold from September to December 2023, with Nvidia buying $20.0 million of preferred stock.
Nvidia buys 291,658 Series B-4 preferred shares of Iambic for $5.0 million in May 2026.
Iambic files its final IPO prospectus at $16.00 per share; Nvidia's preferred converts to common stock.
